title: Passage-Focused Soft Coordination for Hierarchical Multi-Robot Navigation in Bottleneck Environments
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: In multi-robot navigation, rigid global schedules are sensitive to execution deviations, while local methods lack long-horizon coordination. We propose a passage-focused framework combining soft global coordination with flexible local execution. A passage-induced graph of convex sets supports priority-ordered planning with two levels of soft coordination. Passage-aware route selection accounts for passage usage and traversal directions, while route-restricted continuous space-time planning penalizes temporal conflicts. The resulting references guide a model predictive path integral controller that avoids collisions online. Adaptive temporal and geometric tracking accommodates execution deviations, while selective replanning maintains coordination without rigid trajectory reservations. Across 1,200 instances in 4 different environments with 5-30 robots, the framework achieves a near-perfect success rate and outperforms evaluated baselines in makespan and flowtime. Hardware experiments with 8 robots demonstrate successful completion of all trials without collisions. These results highlight the effectiveness of passage-focused coordination in balancing long-horizon cooperation with flexible execution.

AI.tldr: 针对多机器人导航中"刚性全局调度易受执行偏差影响、局部方法缺乏长时程协调"的矛盾，提出通道聚焦的分层框架：软全局协调＋柔性局部执行。作者报告在1200个实例、5–30机器人下成功率接近完美并在makespan与flowtime上优于所评估基线，8机器人硬件实验全部试验无碰撞完成。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出刚性全局调度对执行偏差敏感，而局部方法缺少长时程协调能力，因此瓶颈环境下的多机器人导航需要兼顾长时程合作与执行柔性。
AI.method: 输入是多机器人导航任务（瓶颈环境）。方法先构建由凸集组成的"通道诱导图"，在其上做带优先级的规划，并引入两级软协调：通道感知的路径选择考虑通道占用与通行方向，路径受限的连续时空规划对时间冲突施加惩罚。规划结果作为参考轨迹，交给模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器在线避碰。执行阶段用自适应时间与几何跟踪吸收执行偏差，并用选择性重规划维持协调，而不做刚性轨迹预留。输出是可在线执行、对偏差有柔性响应的多机器人运动参考与控制。
AI.result: 作者报告：在4种环境、5–30机器人共1200个实例中成功率接近完美，且在makespan与flowtime两项指标上优于所评估的基线（摘要未给出具体数值、单位与基线名称）。8机器人硬件实验中所有试验成功完成且无碰撞。摘要未报告具体成功率、makespan/flowtime数值、与最优基线的相对或绝对差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明在瓶颈场景中，以通道为单位的软协调可以把长时程合作与柔性执行结合起来，并同时给出仿真规模测试与8机器人硬件验证的信号。但证据限于摘要：具体指标数值、基线细节、计算开销与统计显著性均未报告，因此"接近完美成功率"与"优于基线"仅为作者陈述，未经独立验证。

title: Robustness as a Transferable Skill: Cross-Task Adversarial Defense for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to adversarial visual perturbations, while defenses often require task-specific adversarial fine-tuning. We investigate whether robustness learned on source manipulation tasks can protect independently specialized target policies without target-side adversarial training. We first show that even a single source defense update improves robustness on held-out tasks, establishing cross-task defense reuse independently of multi-source aggregation. To combine source updates, we introduce Source-Norm Transferable Robustness Vector (SN-TRV), which retains the direction of their mean while calibrating its magnitude using source-update norms. The resulting update is applied to the target visual encoder without target adversarial data, target-side gradient optimization, or additional inference modules. Evaluations across three VLA backbones, fixed and adaptive attacks, and different source defense recipes show improved robustness over naive averaging and identify limits in attack coverage. Physical PiPER trials increase average success under printed adversarial patches from 20.3% to 45.8%.

AI.tldr: VLA 策略易受对抗视觉扰动影响，而防御通常需要针对具体任务做对抗微调。作者提出 SN-TRV：保留多个源任务防御更新均值的方向、用源更新范数校准其幅度，并把该更新施加到目标视觉编码器上，无需目标侧对抗数据、梯度优化或额外推理模块。物理 PiPER 实验中，印刷对抗补丁下的平均成功率从 20.3% 提升到 45.8%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出 VLA 策略对对抗视觉扰动脆弱，而现有防御往往需要任务特定的对抗微调，即每个目标任务都要单独做对抗训练。作者由此追问：在源操作任务上学到的鲁棒性能否直接保护独立专门化的目标策略，而无需目标侧的对抗训练。
AI.method: 输入是若干源操作任务上的防御更新（在 VLA 策略上做对抗微调得到的参数更新向量）以及一个已在目标任务上专门化的目标策略。方法先验证单个源防御更新即可提升留出任务上的鲁棒性，说明跨任务复用不依赖多源聚合；随后提出 SN-TRV，把多个源更新合成为一个向量：保留它们均值的更新方向，同时用源更新的范数来校准该方向的幅度。合成结果被直接施加到目标的视觉编码器上，不需要目标任务的对抗数据、不需要目标侧梯度优化、也不增加推理模块。相对于摘要中提到的“朴素平均”这一合并基线，改变的是多源更新的幅度校准方式。
AI.result: 作者报告：单个源防御更新即可提升留出任务的鲁棒性；在三个 VLA 主干、固定与自适应攻击、不同源防御配方下的评测中，SN-TRV 相比朴素平均取得更好的鲁棒性，并识别出攻击覆盖范围的局限。上述两组结论在摘要中均未给出数值。唯一的数值结果为物理机器人实验：在印刷对抗补丁下，平均成功率由 20.3% 提升到 45.8%（PiPER 平台）。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的启示是：对抗鲁棒性可能像一种可跨任务迁移的“技能”，只需在源操作任务上做防御更新，就能在不触碰目标任务对抗数据的情况下加固其视觉编码器，从而避免逐任务对抗微调的成本。证据边界明显：摘要仅给出物理 PiPER 补丁攻击下成功率 20.3%→45.8% 这一组数值，其余结论（单源更新有效、优于朴素平均）均无数值支撑，且作者自己指出攻击覆盖仍有局限。本文仅基于标题与摘要，未阅读全文，以上均为作者自述，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 把多个源任务对抗微调得到的更新向量按“均值方向 + 源范数校准幅度”合成一个向量，直接加到目标 VLA 的视觉编码器上。

title: ReuseMem: One Memory, Multiple Goals in Robot Manipulation
summary: Robots that work alongside people should be able to use what they have seen when new requests arise. The same experience may later support identifying an object or returning it to its original location, although these uses were unknown during observation. ReuseMem learns to use one visual memory for multiple later manipulation goals. It records visual features independently of future goals, retrieves complementary evidence for each request, and combines it with the current scene through a lightweight action interface. Retrieval is supervised by how well candidate evidence supports expert-action prediction across different current states, linking memory selection to its use in manipulation. Repeated visual features are stored once, and memory computations that remain unchanged during action generation are reused. Experiments on four simulation tasks and two physical scenarios demonstrate reuse of a common recording across different requests. With matched action adaptation, ReuseMem improves joint goal completion on the benchmark tasks by 24.5 percentage points over uniform memory. These findings show that one memory can support multiple later manipulation goals as the scene changes.

AI.tldr: ReuseMem 让机器人把一段与未来目标无关的视觉记忆，用于后续多种操作请求：按请求检索互补证据并与当前场景融合后再出动作。作者报告在四个仿真任务和两个物理场景中复用了同一份记录，benchmark 联合目标完成率相对 uniform memory 提升 24.5 个百分点。

summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of future states. An initial action chunk may be flawed. title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies

summary: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

summary: Diffusion policies, which generate short action sequences by denoising random noise, are a leading way to learn robot skills from demonstrations. Once deployed, they meet constraints the demonstrations never contained, and retraining for each is impractical. A safety filter edits the policy's action to satisfy them, but the edit ignores the task, and a large edit can leave the policy where it cannot continue. We propose CAST (Certified Action Selection at Test time): draw a few action chunks from the frozen policy, certify each with a barrier condition, and execute the certified chunk that a learned value ensemble ranks highest. We prove that a certified step is safe whatever the critic does; that, whenever a certified sample exists, the executed chunk stays within log N nats of the policy conditioned on feasibility, while a safety-filter projection can be singular to it; and that an exact closed-loop identity splits the gain of ranking into availability, spread and the critic's target. Certifying the next chunk is not enough: a generative controller can have safe actions available now and none later. We characterise the safe control authority of a frozen policy under finite sampling, and CAST-V preserves it through a policy-conditioned viability, estimated with a model under a finite-sample guarantee or learned from the controller's own logs (CAST-VL). On robomimic manipulation, a planar quadrotor, a MuJoCo humanoid and a unicycle, with frozen policies, CAST raises joint task-and-constraint success above the output filter in nearly every setting; certifying before ranking is decisive where a filter's edit is large, and viability removes most dead ends that one-step certification cannot see. AI.tldr: 针对冻结扩散策略部署后遇到演示中未含约束、重训不现实的问题，作者提出 CAST：从冻结策略采样多个动作块，先用屏障条件认证、再按学习价值集成排序执行认证通过的块。作者声称在 robomimic 操作、平面四旋翼、MuJoCo 人形与独轮车等冻结策略设置上，联合任务与约束成功率在几乎所有设置中高于输出滤波器，但摘要未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出两个具体缺口：扩散策略按去噪生成短动作序列，部署后会遇到演示数据中不存在的约束，而针对每种约束重训不实际；常规安全滤波器通过编辑动作来满足约束，但该编辑忽略任务，且编辑幅度大时会把策略带到无法继续的状态。摘要进一步指出，只认证下一个动作块不够：生成式控制器可能现在有安全动作、之后没有，即存在"死胡同"。
AI.method: 输入是冻结扩散策略与运行时约束。机制：从冻结策略采样少量动作块（chunk），对每个块用屏障条件做认证，再执行被认证通过、且由学习到的价值集成（value ensemble）排名最高的那一块。相对被比较的"安全滤波器投影"基线，变化在于把"认证"放在"排序"之前，并引入策略条件下的可行性/存续性（viability）评估：CAST-V 用模型估计该存续性并给出有限样本保证，CAST-VL 从控制器自身日志中学习该存续性。输出是被执行的、经认证的动作块及其安全与可行性保证。
AI.result: 作者给出的结果为理论保证与相对比较，摘要未报告任何百分比或数值指标。理论方面：作者证明认证过的步在无论 critic 如何动作时都安全；只要存在认证样本，执行的动作块与策略（在可行条件下）的偏离不超过 log N nats，而安全滤波器投影可能与之奇异；并给出一个精确的闭环恒等式，把排序带来的增益分解为可用性、分散度与 critic 的目标。实验方面为相对性结论：在 robomimic 操作、平面四旋翼、MuJoCo 人形和独轮车、冻结策略的设置下，CAST 的联合任务与约束成功率在几乎所有设置中高于输出滤波器；在滤波器编辑幅度大的地方"先认证后排序"起决定作用，存续性（viability）消除了大部分一步认证看不到的死胡同。摘要未报告具体任务名称、指标数值、样本量或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的启示是：在策略冻结、约束随部署环境变化的场景下，运行时"采样—认证—排序"可以在不改动策略权重的前提下把安全约束与任务性能结合起来，并通过存续性评估避免只做一步认证导致的后续不可行。证据边界：所有结论均为作者自述且未经独立验证；摘要只报告了保证的形式化陈述与相对比较，没有给出数值结果；摘要未报告真机实验（所列 robomimic、平面四旋翼、MuJoCo 人形、独轮车均以仿真基准形式列出），也未报告消融、样本量或计算开销。
